topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe this. I worked on that paper for weeks, pouring over every detail, every source. I made sure to cite everything, exactly as I was taught. To be accused of plagiarism is not just a blow to my academic record; it undermines all the effort, all the nights I stayed up to ensure every i was dotted and every t was crossed. This accusation is a slap in the face, a challenge to my integrity. I know what I did, and I did it right. Now, I have to prove it, to dig through my notes and drafts to show the progression of my work. The thought of it is exhausting, but I have no choice. I'll set the record straight, no matter what it takes.
